referenceLine.policy: behavioral source only; do not merge its stale release authority or overwrite current 1.3 Search & Multi-Target code

invariant: Preserve every v1.3 Search & Multi-Target capability while reconciling the remaining workflow-completion UX gaps. Codex remains conversation/queue authority, Git remains code authority, Forge remains delivery authority, and SQLite stores only local derived/operator state.

outcomes: Board renders only the selected viewport instead of all cards
vertical scrollbar and selection remain coherent for 10k work items
Terminal Drawer reserved rows do not hide Board navigation
WorkCards explicitly represent Goal, Worktree and ChangeRequest relationships
relationship-aware reconciliation remains derived from Codex/Git/Forge authorities
relationship metadata is searchable and visible without creating a second task authority
thread/start and thread/fork are capability-gated upstream operations
new/forked threads can hand off to the existing managed-worktree workflow
unsupported App Servers fail soft without breaking normal threads
global metadata search includes thread identity, cwd, project, Goal, Forge, WorkCard and relationship fields
metadata search does not hydrate transcript bodies
existing full-history transcript search remains a separate Ctrl+F surface
create/edit/delete local Saved Views for source/filter/layout/group/order/visible fields
invalid filters fail before persistence
built-in views remain immutable
Review surfaces explicit pipeline/approval evidence
review change can open in external editor
Forge change request can open in system browser through bounded platform adapters
Thread rendering uses a bounded visible item window
presentation cache is revision-bound and invalidated on conversation changes
large conversations no longer rebuild full presentation on every frame
Ctrl+K palette accepts typed and pasted query text
fuzzy ranking/filtering is bilingual and works on the frozen contextual command set
empty results are explicit and Enter cannot retarget silently
extract workflow-completion responsibilities from mature app/ui/main monoliths
new modules receive explicit no-growth ratchets
v1.3 Search/Queue/Remote/GitHub-write behavior remains regression-covered
exact-SHA 10k Board and Thread render diagnostics run in CI
20 warmups and at least 200 samples retain p50/p95/p99/max
hosted timings remain diagnostic unless a later policy explicitly creates thresholds

rationale: normal GitLab refresh remains intentionally bounded
board membership projection must not silently cross the native-transport trigger
current provider data does not justify claiming card/list membership authority
reopenWhen: bounded membership projection is available without violating refresh budget
real usage demonstrates issue-board membership is required

ratchetPolicy.baseline: inherit v1.3 Search & Multi-Target ceilings; feature work may only add bounded module-specific ceilings
ratchetPolicy.extractionPreference: port behavior, not stale branch structure; extract only when it reduces mature-module growth
ratchetPolicy.noRegression: Search/Queue/Remote/GitHub-safe-mutation modules and contracts may not be weakened
ratchetPolicy.postCompletionBaseline: all v1.4 src/**/*.rs ceilings are frozen at current completion-state LOC; future growth requires explicit governance change

ratchetReviews.scope: Forge partial/total read failures; bounded Review page completion; UI/Headless truthful degradation; negative tests
Unknown active scope fail-closed, queued admission TTL, nonzero Git result reconciliation, targeted negative tests
Synthetic WebSocket notification ordering, close/invalid-message negative fixtures; L1/L2 CI separate from L3 real acceptance
P1 Worktree uncertain removal distinguishes Git metadata from residual disk directory; no green status from split-brain, with retained Failure Matrix and symlink negative tests
Forge merge requires known readiness/approval and write preflight scans complete bounded pages
Exclusive cross-process local SQLite writer/restore lock, opt-in derived transcript index with TTL and record/text budgets, logical cleanup and regression tests
Move transcript search to isolated cancellable read-only session with bounded 12s deadline; reject partial occurrence completeness; mock two-connection regression
Move full quick_check from every SQLite connection to startup and explicit Doctor health; maintain fail-closed startup read-only and add regression coverage
Forge recent first-page summaries and unavailable endpoints must not be treated as exhaustive PR/Pipeline absence; expose bounded coverage in Review, Board provenance and bilingual UI
Preserve raw GitHub Issues API page saturation before PR filtering; prevent zero-row false absence in Forge/Board provenance
Preserve GitHub raw-page saturation even when derived Issues filter removes all PRs; normalize fixture/source formatting
Short local SQLite LIKE searches quote %, _ and backslash literally; negative real-store regression protects against wildcard overmatch
Yield main RPC on an inbound interactive server request while preserving buffered event and unknown RPC outcome, with real mock WebSocket deadlock test
Preserve first local transcript observation across replay so 30-day retention is not silently extended; bound persisted title as well as message body; real-SQLite negative fixtures.

GitHub source repository provenance governs branch projection and write preflight; fork/missing head source cannot impersonate local branch. Negative fixture for same short ref in different head repos.

GitLab MR source_project_id and target_project_id must match selected project before branch-bound writes, while cross-project MRs stay clearly qualified read-only; no fork ref collision in duplicate preflight.
